jobs.occupation: Restaurant manager for Bagel Bites
jobs.description:
About Us

At Bagel Bites, good food and good service go hand in hand. Following a small restructuring of our management team, we are now looking for someone who can take responsibility for the day-to-day delegation of tasks and administration.

Responsibilities

As Restaurant Manager, you will play a key role in the daily operation of the restaurant. Your primary responsibilities will include:

• 
Developing the company’s overall marketing strategy.

• 
Supervising restaurant employees, effectively delegating tasks, and handling customer matters.

• 
Potentially managing the company’s social media accounts.

• 
Contributing to financial administration, including budgeting, reporting, and accounting.

Qualifications

We are looking for a qualified candidate with the following skills and competencies:

• 
Relevant education or experience in management, preferably within the restaurant or service industry.

• 
Communication skills to develop effective marketing messages.

Application

If you believe your experience and skills match our requirements, we encourage you to send your application and CV to info@sundsult.dk or rkbgaps@gmail.com, with the subject line: “Application Manager.”

Dansk

Om os:

Hos Bagel Bites går god mad og god service hånd i hånd, og efter en lille omrokering af vores ledelse søger vi nu en person, som kan stå for den daglige uddelegering af opgaver og administration.

Ansvarsområder:

Som restaurantmanager vil du være en nøglefigur i den daglige drift af restauranten. Dine primære ansvarsområder vil omfatte:

• 
Udvikling af virksomhedens overordnede markedsføringsstrategi.

• 
Opsyn med restaurantens ansatte, effektiv uddelegering af arbejdsopgaver samt kundehåndtering.

• 
Evt. administration af virksomhedens sociale medier.

• 
Bidrag til den økonomiske administration, herunder budgettering, rapportering og regnskabsarbejde.

Kvalifikationer:

Vi søger en kvalificeret kandidat med følgende kompetencer:

• 
Relevant uddannelse eller erfaring inden for ledelse, gerne inden for restaurant- eller servicebranchen.

• 
Kommunikationsevner til at udforme effektive markedsføringsbudskaber.

Ansøgning:

Hvis du mener, at din erfaring og dine kompetencer matcher vores krav, opfordrer vi dig til at sende din ansøgning og dit CV til info@sundsult.dk eller rkbgaps@gmail.com med emnet: ”Ansøgning manager”.

jobs.occupation: BM-Gulvservice ApS is hiring a Floor Layer with Mechanical Skills
jobs.description:
BM-Gulvservice ApS is looking for a motivated Floor Layer to join our team working with the installation, renovation and finishing of wooden floors.

Your primary responsibility will be practical flooring work at customer sites. We are particularly interested in applicants with good mechanical understanding who can also help maintain our equipment, identify faults and carry out minor mechanical repairs when needed.

Job title: Floor Layer
DISCO-08 code: 712200

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

• 
Measure and prepare work areas and subfloors.

• 
Cut, fit and install wooden flooring.

• 
Sand and renovate existing wooden floors.

• 
Prepare surfaces and apply finishing treatments.

• 
Check the quality of completed work, including joints, levels and surface finish.

• 
Operate flooring machinery and carry out routine equipment checks and maintenance.

• 
Identify common mechanical faults and perform minor repairs or adjustments at customer sites, within your competence and according to manufacturer instructions.

• 
Report faults requiring specialist repair and keep tools and equipment in good working condition.

YOUR PROFILE

We are looking for someone who:

• 
Has a practical or technical background and an interest in quality flooring work.

• 
Works accurately with measurements, materials and tools.

• 
Has good mechanical understanding and practical skills in equipment maintenance and minor repairs.

• 
Can approach mechanical problems systematically and recognise when specialist assistance is required.

• 
Is reliable, takes responsibility and works well with colleagues.

• 
Can communicate in English and understand work and safety instructions.

Previous experience with wooden flooring is an advantage. Relevant technical training and practical skills gained in another field will also be considered.

Training in our flooring methods and familiarisation with our specific equipment will be provided according to your background.

WE OFFER

• 
A full-time position primarily focused on wooden flooring.

• 
Varied installation and renovation projects at customer sites.

• 
The opportunity to use and develop both flooring and mechanical skills.

• 
Cooperation with experienced colleagues.

• 
Salary according to qualifications and employment conditions consistent with Danish standards.

HOW TO APPLY

We welcome applications from candidates in Denmark and abroad.

Please send your CV, relevant certificates and a short application in English using the contact details provided in this advertisement.

Describe your practical background and any experience with flooring, tools, machinery maintenance or repairs.

Start date by agreement, subject to any required work authorisation.

BM-Gulvservice ApS

jobs.occupation: Better Nitrogen efficiency by improving Cow Resilience, Eating Dynamics, Breeding and Lifetime Efficiency
jobs.employer_name: Center for Kvantitativ Genetik og Genomforskning
jobs.description:
Applicants are invited for a PhD fellowship/scholarship at Graduate School of Technical Sciences, Aarhus University, Denmark, within the Quantitative Genetics and Genomics programme. The position is available from 1 March 2027 or later. You can submit your application via the link under 'how to apply'.

Title
Better Nitrogen efficiency by improving Cow Resilience, Eating Dynamics, Breeding and Lifetime Efficiency

Research area and project description
The Center for Quantitative Genetics and Genomics (QGG) holds a leading position in cattle breeding research, particularly in genetic studies on data generated by advanced phenotyping technologies such as the CFIT 3D camera system through industry collaboration with VikingGenetics. This state-of-the-art system enables large-scale, non-invasive measurement of feed intake, body weight, and milk production data in over 30,000 cows directly in their production environment. This PhD project will leverage this extensive phenotypic dataset generated by CFIT, in combination with feeding parameters and other phenotypes from the Danish Cattle Database, to develop genetic tools aimed at enhancing nitrogen efficiency, resilience, eating dynamics and feed efficiency. The goal is to develop novel genomic breeding values for nitrogen efficiency, while considering other important breeding goal traits (e.g., productivity, health, fertility) and other traits, such as resilience, eating dynamics and feed efficiency. The project will apply advanced statistical methods, artificial intelligence, and cutting-edge genetic models to support and enhance management and breeding decision-making by dairy farmers. This project offers a unique opportunity to contribute to the green transition in agriculture by breeding cows that are both more sustainable and economically viable for the future of Danish dairy farming. We encourage candidates finishing their MSc in summer 2027 also to apply.

Qualifications and specific competences
A relevant master’s degree (120 ECTS) in Animal Breeding
Experience with data handling softwares (e.g., R, SAS, Python, Unix Shell) and genetic softwares (e.g., DMU, BLUPF90, AIREML).
Background in working with Livestock data is an advantage.
The ability to speak and write English fluently is a prerequisite for the applicant.
Can speak and write English fluently is a prerequisite.

Place of employment and place of work
The place of employment is Aarhus University, and the place of work is Center for Quantitative Genetics and Genomics, C.F. Møllers Allé 3, 8000 Aarhus C., Denmark.

Contacts
Applicants seeking further information regarding the PhD position are invited to contact:
• Associate Professor Bingjie Li, e-mail: bingjie.li@qgg.au.dk (main supervisor)
• Tenure Track Assistant Professor Rasmus Bak Stephansen, e-mail: rasmus.stephansen@qgg.au.dk (co-supervisor)For information about application requirements and mandatory attachments, please see our application guide. If answers cannot be found there, please contact:
• admission.gradschool.tech@au.dk 
How to apply
Please follow this link to submit your application.

Application deadline is 29 November 2026 23:59 CET.

Preferred starting date is 01 March 2027.

For technical reasons, you must upload a project description. Please copy the project description above and upload it as a PDF in the application.

Please note:
• Only documents received prior to the application deadline will be evaluated. Thus, documents sent after deadline will not be considered.
• The programme committee may request further information or invite the applicant to attend an interview.
• Shortlisting will be used, which means that the evaluation committee only will evaluate the most relevant applications.
Formalities and salary range
Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Confederation of Professional Unions. You will be employed as an academic staff member at basic salary grades 4–8. As a PhD fellow you will also receive a monthly non-pensionable allowance.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

The application must be submitted via the online recruitment system, which can be accessed under ‘How to apply’.

jobs.occupation: Two 3-year Postdoc positions in Leadership Studies
jobs.description:
Copenhagen Business School invites applications for two vacant 3-year Postdoc positions in Leadership Studies, both based on a broad understanding of leadership as studies of both governance, organising and management. One Postdoc position will be affiliated with Department of Management, Society and Communication and the other with Department of Organisation. For more information about the two departments, please follow the links.

The two positions form part of CBS Executive Education’s Talent Programme (ETP). The ETP sets out to strengthen CBS’ leadership related research and education capacity within executive education and life-long learning. Expected starting date is 15 February 2027.

Examples of research areas that the Postdocs might cover:

• Leadership Studies with a particular focus on leadership practices and developments in the Nordic context
• Leadership Studies with a particular focus on life-long learning for working professions
The Postdoc positions are non-tenured positions, each for a three-year period with both research and teaching obligations.

To fulfill the research requirements of the positions, the applicants chosen are expected to be physically present on a regular basis and actively participate in the teaching and research activities of their respective Departments.

Qualifications

Applicants must hold a PhD or the equivalent. In assessing applications, particular emphasis will be placed on

• Research potential within different aspects of leadership studies in a Nordic context and within life-long learning for working professionals.
• Demonstrable experience with executive education and external engagement based on direct participation in executive education activities, including development and teaching of high-quality offerings in the executive education area.
• Demonstrable interest in developing and co-creating new educational formats that address changing learning and competence needs of relevance for life-long learning, in part by further developing CBS Executive Education’s collaboration with external partners and the CBS Executive Education Foundation.
• Professional proficiency in both Danish and English (written and spoken).
Copenhagen Business School has a broad commitment to the excellence, distinctiveness and relevance of its teaching and research programmes. Candidates who wish to join us should demonstrate enthusiasm for working in an organisation of this type.

The application must include:

• A summary of the candidate’s key abilities and qualifications.
• A complete, numbered list of publications (indicating titles, co-authors, page numbers and year) with an * marking of the academic productions to be considered during the review. A maximum of 5 publications for review is allowed. Applicants are requested to prioritise their publications in relation to the field of this job advertisement.
• Copies of the publications marked with an *. Only publications written in English (or another specified principal language, according to research tradition) or one of the Scandinavian languages will be taken into consideration)
• Information indicating experience in research management, teaching incl executive education, industry co-operation and international co-operation.
• Documentation of relevant, significant, original research at an international level.
• Transcript(s) and a full CV
Recruitment procedure

The Recruitment Committee will shortlist a minimum of two applicants; when possible five or more applicants will be shortlisted. The shortlisted applicants will be assessed by the Assessment Committee. All applicants will be notified of their status in the recruitment process shortly after the application deadline. 

The applicants selected for assessment will be notified about the composition of the Assessment Committee and later in the process about the result of the assessment.

Once the recruitment process has been completed each applicant will be notified of the outcome of their application.

For further information please contact: Head of Department MSC Dorte Salskov-Iversen tel.: +45 3815 3181, e-mail dsi.msc@cbs.dk.

For information on the recruitment process, please contact: jobcall.msc@cbs.dk

Appointment and salary will be in accordance with the Ministry of Finance’s agreement with the Central Academic Organisation.

Application: Application must be sent via the electronic recruitment system.

Application deadline: 19 November 2026

Copenhagen Business School must receive all application material, including all appendices (see items above), by the application deadline.

WE TRANSFORM SOCIETY WITH BUSINESS

CBS is a globally recognised business school with deep roots in the Nordic socio-economic model. Our faculty has a broad focus on societal challenges, and we have earned a reputation for high-quality disciplinary and interdisciplinary research and education.
We are located at Frederiksberg and have approximately 20,000 full and part-time students, 800 full-time faculty members, 200 PhD students and 700 administrative staff, and a full portfolio of bachelor, master, MBA/EMBA, PhD and executive programmes taught in English and Danish.
Our global profile carries the obligation to address critical challenges in our research and to develop the transformational capabilities of students, graduates and business leaders via our educational activities and opportunities for lifelong learning. Complex challenges call for joint action, and therefore our strategy focuses on strengthening current and starting new partnerships with other sciences, the business community, authorities and civil society.
CBS is working continuously on becoming a diverse and inclusive organisation, and we encourage all regardless of gender identity and expression, ethnicity, religious beliefs, LGBT+ identity, cultural background etc. to apply.Reach out to us if you need assistance in the application or recruitment process, if there is something we should know, or if as a person with disability you wish to make use of your preferential access.

Opvaskere søges til Ruths Hotel i Gl. Skagen

På Ruths Hotel er opvasken en vigtig del af den samlede gæsteoplevelse. Bag enhver vellykket servering står et stærkt team, hvor alle tager ansvar for, at kvalitet, hygiejne og arbejdsgange fungerer - også når tempoet er højt.

Vi søger opvaskere, som har lyst til at blive en del af et professionelt køkken og et hus, hvor værtskab, samarbejde og ordentlighed er en del af kulturen. Du behøver ikke at have erfaring fra hotel- eller restaurationsbranchen. Det vigtigste er, at du møder stabilt, tager ansvar og bidrager positivt til fællesskabet.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

• 
Opvask af service, glas, bestik og køkkenudstyr

• 
Holde orden og sikre god hygiejne i opvaskeområdet

• 
Hjælpe med rengøring og lettere praktiske opgaver i køkkenet

• 
Sørge for, at rent udstyr er klar, når kollegerne har brug for det

• 
Samarbejde tæt med køkkenet og resten af hotellets team

Vi leder efter dig, der

• 
Er stabil, ansvarsbevidst og møder til tiden

• 
Arbejder effektivt og bevarer overblikket, når der er travlt

• 
Har sans for orden, renlighed og hygiejne

• 
Er en god kollega og hjælper, hvor der er behov

• 
Har en positiv indstilling og lyst til at være en del af et fællesskab

• 
Kan arbejde på skiftende tidspunkter, herunder aftener og weekender

Vi tilbyder

• 
En arbejdsplads på et ikonisk hotel med historie, sjæl og høje ambitioner

• 
Et stærkt fællesskab, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og løfter i flok

• 
En kultur præget af stolthed, nærvær og ordentlighed

• 
Grundig oplæring og mulighed for udvikling

• 
En varieret hverdag i særlige omgivelser

• 
Mulighed for personalebolig

På Ruths Hotel tror vi på, at de bedste gæsteoplevelser skabes i fællesskab. Som opvasker er du en vigtig del af holdet og med til at sikre, at både køkken og restaurant kan levere værtskab på højeste niveau.

Send din ansøgning og dit CV til job@ruths-hotel.dk.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Jack Cramer på samme e-mailadresse.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

At Ruths Hotel, the dishwashing team plays an important role in the overall guest experience. Behind every successful service is a strong team in which everyone takes responsibility for maintaining quality, hygiene and efficient workflows - even during busy periods.

We are looking for dishwashers who would like to join a professional kitchen and a hotel where hospitality, teamwork and reliability are part of the culture. Previous experience from the hotel or restaurant industry is not required. What matters most is that you are dependable, take responsibility and contribute positively to the team.

Your responsibilities

• 
Washing plates, glasses, cutlery and kitchen equipment

• 
Maintaining order and high hygiene standards in the dishwashing area

• 
Assisting with cleaning and other practical tasks in the kitchen

• 
Ensuring that clean equipment is ready when your colleagues need it

• 
Working closely with the kitchen team and other hotel departments

We are looking for someone who

• 
Is reliable, responsible and punctual

• 
Works efficiently and stays organised during busy periods

• 
Has a strong focus on cleanliness, order and hygiene

• 
Is a supportive colleague who is willing to help where needed

• 
Has a positive attitude and enjoys being part of a team

• 
Is available for flexible working hours, including evenings and weekends

We offer

• 
A workplace at an iconic hotel with history, character and high ambitions

• 
A strong team culture in which colleagues support one another

• 
A working environment built on pride, care and professionalism

• 
Thorough training and opportunities for development

• 
A varied working day in unique surroundings

• 
The possibility of staff accommodation

At Ruths Hotel, we believe that the best guest experiences are created through teamwork. As a dishwasher, you are an important part of the team and help ensure that our kitchen and restaurant can deliver hospitality at the highest level.

Please send your application and CV to job@ruths-hotel.dk.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Jack Cramer at the same email address.

We look forward to hearing from you.

jobs.occupation: PhD Position in Energy Harvesting for Bio-Inspired Flying Robots
jobs.description:
The section of Digital and High-Frequency Electronics in Odense at the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering at the Faculty of Engineering of the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applications for a PhD position in energy harvesting for bio-inspired flying robots. The position focuses on developing energy-harvesting techniques that use the magnetic fields surrounding high-voltage power lines to support autonomous inspection of power lines. The starting date is 1 January 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.  

This is a three-year PhD position based at SDU’s campus in Odense, Denmark.

The section focuses on conducting research in digital and high-frequency electronics, embedded systems, control, and communication, utilizing cutting-edge reconfigurable computing and sensors. The aim is to develop next-generation electronics and computing solutions that solve technology-related challenges in fields such as autonomous robots, drones, IoT, smart grid, and healthcare.

The section contributes to our educational programmes in electrical engineering in Odense, offering Bachelor’s and Master of Science degrees in Electronics Engineering. Its activities span research, industrial collaboration, and education in electrical engineering and related areas.

The SDU campus in Odense comprises six faculties, bringing together academics and students in an environment that supports interdisciplinary research and a rich student life. Odense offers a vibrant robotics community, cultural activities, attractive residential areas, and green spaces along the river that runs through the city centre.

 

Job Description

We are seeking a highly motivated PhD candidate to join the FreeFly project, an ambitious research project focused on developing a bird-like flying robot for autonomous inspection of power lines. The PhD research will focus on energy harvesting to enable self-sustaining operation of this bio-inspired robotic platform.

Research Focus – Energy Harvesting for Bio-Inspired Flying Robots

You will investigate, analyse, and design novel energy-harvesting techniques that enable bio-inspired aerial robots to draw energy from the strong magnetic fields surrounding high-voltage power lines. Your research will contribute to the development of self-sustaining flying robotic systems, with the aim of enabling extended autonomous inspection missions.

General Responsibilities

As a PhD student on this project, you will:

• 
Conduct research on energy harvesting from the magnetic fields surrounding high-voltage power lines, contributing to the development of a self-sustaining, bird-like autonomous flying robot for inspection of power lines.

• 
Participate in teaching activities, including course planning and instruction in relevant subject areas.

• 
Collaborate closely with fellow PhD students, postdocs, and other members of the research group in a dynamic, interdisciplinary environment.

We are looking for a detail-oriented, self-driven candidate with a strong interest in energy harvesting and its application to bio-inspired flying robots. If you are motivated to contribute to innovative research in autonomous inspection of power lines, we encourage you to apply.

 

Required Qualifications

• 
A completed BSc and MSc in electronics, electrical engineering, physics, mechatronics, or a closely related discipline. Applicants in the final semester of their master’s programme are also encouraged to apply, provided they complete their MSc before the starting date and meet the applicable PhD admission requirements.

• 
Strong technical skills relevant to energy harvesting, particularly magnetic-field energy harvesting, electronics, and embedded hardware architectures.

• 
Demonstrated ability in academic writing, including preparing scientific reports, documentation, and research publications.

For further information about the position, please contact the Head of Digital and High-frequency Electronics section, Professor Emad Samuel Malki Ebeid, e-mail: esme@sdu.dk.

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Before applying the candidates are advised to read the Faculty information for prospective PhD students and the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

• 
Motivated application that clearly explains the applicant’s interest, qualifications, and motivation for the position (max. 2 pages). 

• 
Detailed Curriculum Vitae, including personal contact information, skills, along with any other relevant information, e.g. teaching experience, computational skills, relevant projects, etc.

• 
Master’s and Bachelor’s degree certificates or equivalent, including transcripts of grades (original and an official English translation). Applicants in the final semester of their master’s programme are requested to submit transcripts from all completed semesters. 

• 
Completed TEK PhD application form for 5+3 applicants. Find the form at the Faculty website.

• 
Completed TEK PhD form for calculation grade point average. Find the form at the Faculty website. 

• 
An official document describing the grading scheme of the awarding universities (if not Danish). 

• 
Only for applicants from programmes that evaluate thesis/examination project by approved/not approved: An official written assessment of the thesis or dissertation project from the grade giving institution. The statement must clearly state that the candidate has been among the top 30 pct. in the graduation class for the study programme.

• 
List of publications and maximum 2 examples of relevant publications (in case you have any publications).

• 
Up to three names and emails of researchers who can provide an informed reference letter at short notice. (Reference letters and other relevant qualifications may also be included.)

• 
A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected.

jobs.description:
The section of Digital and High-Frequency Electronics at the University of Southern Denmark invites applications for an Assistant Professor position in Energy Harvesting and EMI Mitigation for Drones and Robots in High-Voltage Environments. The position is open from January 1, 2027, and the starting date will be agreed with the successful candidate.

 

Job Content

The Assistant Professor will conduct research within energy harvesting for drones, robotic systems, and IoT applications, with a particular focus on enhancing power density and enabling long-term autonomous operation. The research will further address electromagnetic interference (EMI) mitigation and electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) for electronic and robotic systems operating in extreme high-voltage environments, contributing to improved system reliability, safety, and performance in infrastructure inspection and maintenance applications.

The successful candidate is expected to develop and sustain a research agenda aligned with or complementing the section’s activities, establish an internationally recognized research profile, publish in high-impact journals and leading international conference proceedings, and actively contribute to securing external research funding from national and international sources. The role includes collaboration with academic colleagues and industrial partners and participation in national and international research activities.

The position includes planning, teaching, and developing Bachelor’s and Master’s-level courses in relevant areas of electronics and electrical engineering. The successful candidate will supervise Bachelor’s, Master’s, and PhD students, provide academic guidance, and contribute to a supportive and collaborative research and learning environment. The role also includes academic service at section and department levels and participation in relevant professional activities.

 

Required Qualifications

Applicants must hold a PhD degree in Electronics Engineering, Power Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related field.

Applicants must document the following qualifications and experience:

• 
A strong research track record in electromagnetic energy harvesting, power conversion, or power management systems.

• 
Research experience in electromagnetic interference (EMI) mitigation and electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) for operation in extreme high-voltage environments up to 500 kV.

• 
Experience in the design, development, and testing of drone systems.

Experience in university teaching, course development, and supervision of engineering students, together with pedagogical and subject-specific skills appropriate to the position.

•

•

International research experience gained in an environment other than the institution where the applicant completed their PhD will be considered an advantage.

The section of Digital and High-Frequency Electronics at the University of Southern Denmark conducts research in digital and high-frequency electronics, embedded systems, control, and communications, using advanced reconfigurable computing and sensing technologies. The section contributes to the electrical engineering programmes in Odense, including Bachelor’s and Master of Science degrees in Electronics Engineering. SDU’s Odense campus comprises six faculties, providing opportunities for interdisciplinary research and a vibrant student life. Odense offers a culturally rich environment, a growing robotics community, attractive residential areas, and green spaces along the river through the city centre.

jobs.occupation: Senior Manager, Solution & Data Architecture
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Senior Manager, Data & AI Architecture, based in Copenhagen or London, to lead our team of four Data, AI and Solution Architects and serve as the design authority for Pandora’s Data & AI platform. This is a genuine dual role. You’ll set the architectural direction and standards, while remaining close enough to the technology to challenge, review and approve the designs that matter.

Our target architecture is Databricks, including Delta Lake, medallion patterns and Unity Catalog, while Azure Synapse and its conformed enterprise models continue to power a significant part of the estate across supply chain, commerce, manufacturing, corporate technology and omni-channel.

A critical part of the role is leading the transition to Databricks: shaping the target architecture, determining where ownership sits as the platform evolves, and ensuring existing solutions remain coherent and supported throughout the journey.

The role is approximately 60% architecture and 40% people leadership. You’ll lead and develop four architects, but this is not a role where technical accountability is delegated to the team. Both sides of the role are real, and you’ll be expected to lead both.

Scope and authority

• Design authority for Data & Analytics: approves data and AI solution designs, and can require rework, attach conditions to an approval, or withhold approval.

• Chairs the architecture review forum, setting its standards, cadence and quality gates, and deciding what requires review against what is already covered by an approved pattern.

• Resolves conflicting design positions across architects, lead engineers and delivery teams.

• Owns reference architectures, solution patterns, data contracts and architecture decision records — accountable for their adoption, not just their publication.

• Owns the team's roadmap, capacity allocation across workstreams, and budget, including engagement of external consulting resources.

• Translates and enforces the Data & AI architecture strategy set by the Global Director, and informs how it evolves.

Job Responsibilities

Architecture

• Set and enforce the standards for what is built on Databricks as the target architecture, what remains on Synapse for now, and what is retired — and on what evidence.

• Decide how data products are aligned: source-aligned versus domain-aligned versus consumer-aligned, where ownership and stewardship sit, and where a conformed enterprise model (CDM/RDM) serves better than distributed ownership.

• Review technical designs from solution architects and lead engineers against platform standards; give feedback that changes the design, not just documents it.

• Define and evolve reference architectures, solution patterns and data contracts so that quality is built in rather than inspected in.

• Lead design sessions with architects, engineering and business stakeholders on complex or contested problems.

• Oversee transitional architectures through to legacy decommission, maintaining business continuity and closing the parallel run.

AI architecture

• Set and enforce architecture standards for agentic systems: orchestration, tool and data access boundaries, evaluation, guardrails and observability.

• Set and enforce architecture standards for ML systems: feature reuse, training and serving topology, model lifecycle, and monitoring for drift.

• Approve AI solution designs with enough depth to arbitrate them on the technical merits, and in line with AI policy and applicable regulation.

Governance and regulation

• Embed privacy-by-design and personal data handling requirements into platform patterns, particularly across commerce and omni-channel.

• Maintain computational governance: data quality frameworks, contracts and lineage as platform capability rather than project effort.

Team leadership

• Line management for four architects: coaching, performance, career development, hiring.

• Establish ways of working — review process, documentation standards, quality gates — and hold the team to them.

• Represent architecture in leadership forums, steering committees and cross-functional planning.

• Keep architects hands-on and embedded with engineering teams; architecture produced at a distance from delivery does not land.

What you will have done by month 12

• A published and adopted standard for what is built on Databricks, with evidence of designs changed by it.

• A clear model for data product alignment and ownership, applied on live work rather than documented in isolation.

• An architecture review forum running to a predictable cadence, with a visible ADR record and a known path for challenging a decision.

• Approved agentic and ML reference patterns in use.

• At least one legacy component fully decommissioned, not just superseded.

• A development plan in place for each of the four architects, and any open roles filled.

Essential experience

• 5+ years designing and delivering production data platform solutions at enterprise scale, hands-on.

• At least 2 years line-managing technical specialists, including performance management, career development and hiring.

• Has held a design approval or architecture governance mandate, including declining designs and making that decision hold.

• Has led a platform migration or a parallel-run estate through to legacy decommission.

• Deep working knowledge of Databricks (Delta Lake, medallion, Unity Catalog) as a target architecture, plus enough Azure Synapse (star schemas, conformed models, dedicated pools) to govern what remains there, and pipeline orchestration with ADF or Databricks Workflows.

• Has designed source-aligned, domain-aligned and consumer-aligned data products, with a clear view of where distributed domain ownership beats a conformed enterprise model (CDM/RDM) and where it does not.

• Has implemented or governed a domain ownership model — data mesh or similar — including the federated governance and stewardship that makes it work.

• Has architected agentic and ML systems: orchestration, tool and data access boundaries, evaluation and guardrails; feature and model lifecycle, serving, and monitoring for drift.

• Has set architecture standards that others adopted — solution patterns, reference architectures and architecture decision records.

• Has implemented data quality frameworks, data contracts or computational governance in production.

• Holds an architectural position under delivery pressure, and judges well when to concede.

• Communicates architecture clearly to technical and business audiences, including solution designs, ADRs and data flow diagrams.

• Understanding of retail, manufacturing, finance or supply chain business processes and how data flows through a business.

Desirable

• Familiarity with EU AI Act obligations and enterprise AI governance.

Did we get your attention?

We hope you got all your questions answered and feel confident applying for this position. If you see yourself in the role and would like to become a part of Pandora’s future, please do not hesitate to apply! We are an international team, so please make sure to send us your application in English to be considered. We look forward to hearing from you!

We process applications on a continuous basis, which is why we encourage you to send your application as soon as possible. You can also read more about Pandora on our corporate site www.pandoragroup.com.

Icing on the cake

You will be working out of our beautiful Digital & Technology Hub in Copenhagen, in a rapidly growing environment of highly skilled and experienced colleagues, which is a key initiative that goes along with Pandora’s experience & ambitions.Besides our beautiful interior design, we are also proud of our LEED Gold Certification for Energy and Environmental Design. This means that we use as few natural resources as possible and that we use them with respect. The result is a professional and dynamic space that is unique, comfortable and inspirational – and delivers a true Pandora experience to anyone who works here or comes to visit.

About Pandora

Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

jobs.occupation: End to End Planner
jobs.description:
Curious about a role where you can make a real difference to production planning? As our End-to-End Planner, you will connect Operations, Procurement and Commercial—turning complex supply challenges into clear plans and informed decisions.

**The role

**You will own operational and tactical planning for relevant production lines, help balancing production, purchasing, inventory and customer needs. You will also contribute to a stronger, globally consistent planning processes.

**Your Main Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Managing the full planning horizon in SAP ePPDS, from operational to tactical levels, including placing purchase orders with suppliers

• Maintaining and acting on SAP exception reports daily, managing process orders and due dates, and addressing risks to order fulfillment and stock levels in the monthly S&OP process

• Planning specific production lines in Frederikssund while ensuring alignment with global operations. Develop and maintain production plans while keeping a global overview.

• Owning the monthly Sales & Operations (S&OP) supply reviews for your lines, presenting data-driven insights, imbalances and trade-off scenarios

• Optimizing inventory and safety-stock levels, and support continuous improvement of planning processes

After your first year, success will mean that production lines have clear plans for order volumes and start/end dates. Decision-makers can make aligned, fact-based decisions, and risks to order fulfilment or inventory are identified, escalated and addressed in time.

**What You Bring

**We expect that you have some years of practical experience with integrated supply chain planning, ideally in process industry or a technology-service environment. You have obtained knowledge of the S&OP cycle and supply planning for finished goods and/or raw materials, probably in a production environment.

Strong proficiency in SAP ePPDS, APS solutions, Business Warehouse, Excel and PowerPoint.

As a person you have a structured, analytical approach, you pay attention to detail and have the ability to turn complex data into clear decision-making material. You succeed in your stakeholder management because of your strong communication and collaboration skills and the confidence to work across functions.

On the more formal side, you hold a relevant academic technical engineering, Supply Chain Management or Economics degree.

Fluency in written and spoken English, as well as Danish, is a prerequisite.

The role requires physic presence in Lyngby and Frederikssund.

**Why join us

**You will have a hands-on role with a broad view of the planning process—from daily operational decisions to tactical supply planning. Your analyses and recommendations will help balance production, purchasing, inventory and customer delivery needs.

At Topsoe, we are united by a shared purpose: helping our customers and partners accelerate the energy transition. You will join a company built on innovation, collaboration, and a commitment to solving some of the world's most important challenges.

**Your new team

**You will be a part of a team of 9 who work closely with colleagues across Operations, Procurement, Commercial and other relevant functions, as well as stakeholders at the production site in Frederikssund. Together, you will surface planning challenges early, align on priorities and support decisions that keep production and supply plans on track.

**How To Apply

**If you would like to be part of a global company that combines technology leadership with meaningful impact, we would love to hear from you.

Please submit your application and CV in English. For questions regarding the position, please contact Jesper Koch Olsen, JKOL@topsoe.com.

Application deadline: November 11, 2026.

We welcome applications from all qualified candidates, irrespective of their gender, age, religion, disability, ethnic background, and geographical location. We encourage individuals from diverse cultures and countries to apply and contribute to our global team.

To ensure a secure and trustworthy work environment, our recruitment process may include background checks, requests for criminal records, and contact with references.

_To headhunters: Thank you for your interest in our company. However, we would like to inform you that we have a dedicated internal team managing our recruitment process. We kindly request that you refrain from reaching out to us regarding potential candidates. Thank you for your understanding.

_**About Us

**Topsoe is a leading global provider of advanced technology and solutions for the energy transition.

Built on decades of scientific research and innovation, we are working with customers and partners to drive energy resiliency and to achieve their sustainability goals.

We offer world-leading solutions for transforming renewable resources into fuels and chemicals, and we provide technologies needed to produce low-carbon and conventional fuels and chemicals as well as ensuring clean air.

We were founded in 1940 and are headquartered in Denmark, serving customers all around the globe. To learn more, visit www.topsoe.com.

jobs.occupation: Product Manager, CTO Area
jobs.description:
_Do you want to shape how the world’s largest dedicated fund manager within greenfield renewable energy uses AI to deploy capital? If so, CIP Fund Solutions (CIP FS) is looking for a Product Manager to join our Digital & AI team in Copenhagen, Denmark.

_**Team

**As Product Manager, you will join the Digital & AI team in CIP Fund Solutions, reporting to the Investment Lifecycle Lead. You will be part of a new delivery unit, developing and rolling out digital and AI solutions that will bring efficiency to CIP’s investment teams.

**Role

**Behind every investment decision at CIP sit data rooms, contracts, financial models and investment committee materials. As Product Manager, you will find where AI saves the investment teams the most time or improves their decisions and turn that into products they use every day. You will own the AI product roadmap for the investment lifecycle, from identifying use cases through delivery, adoption and measured impact.

**Responsibilities will consist of but are not limited to:

**

• Embed with investment teams to map workflows and quantify where AI adds value.

• Own and prioritize the AI product roadmap for the investment lifecycle.

• Turn business problems into requirements, success metrics and acceptance criteria for engineering.

• Prototype and demo concepts with users before committing engineering capacity.

• Drive adoption and report impact in time saved, cycle time and usage.

• Assess external AI vendors against internal build options, and make sure solutions meet CIP’s security, data protection and responsible AI requirements.

**You

**You have a master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Finance, Economics or a related field, and bring 5-8 years of experience in product management, management consulting, technology delivery or an investment role.

You have a track record of taking data or AI products from problem definition to adoption by business users, and working knowledge of LLMs, AI agents and retrieval-based solutions. You are technically fluent (basic Python or SQL, APIs, AI prototyping tools) and can build demos and work credibly with engineers. Experience from infrastructure, private equity, project finance or energy is considered beneficial.

**We look for the following in a candidate:

**

• Solid stakeholder management and the credibility to challenge senior investment professionals.

• Clear, concise communication, with the ability to explain complex topics simply.

• Structured and commercially minded, with a focus on where AI creates the most value.

• Ownership of ambiguous problems and the drive to see solutions through to adoption.

• Highly proficient written and verbal English. Danish is not a requirement.

**The process

**Please apply online as soon as possible as applications will be processed on an ongoing basis. For questions related to the role, please reach out to our Talent Acquisition team at recruitment@cipfs.com. We do not include CV's and Cover Letters sent by email.

As we continue to improve our candidate experience, diversity and avoid unconscious bias, please avoid having a photo in your CV. We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality for all applicants.

Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations and ownership.

---

**CIP Fund Solutions’ commitment to diversity and inclusion

**CIP Fund Solutions is committed to securing a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels respected and heard.

A diverse workforce allows CIP Fund Solutions to achieve results through different approaches and solutions to task execution and problem solving. We want all our employees to have equal opportunities for personal growth and career opportunities regardless of age, gender, sexual orientation, disability, religion, nationality, or ethnicity.

**CIP Fund Solutions

**CIP FS’ purpose is to enable CIP’s ambition to scale rapidly over the coming strategy-period - supporting our colleagues with professional and efficient financial, legal, tax and business operations through the cycle from fund formation and capital raising, to deploying investments into construction of large-scale greenfield renewable energy assets, as well as M&A.

For more information, please visit CIP Fund Solutions.
